title: 两句话中的不常见单词
summary: 若一个单词在两句话合计恰出现一次，则它不常见；返回所有不常见单词。
insight: 统一统计两句话全部词频，再按两句原始出现顺序输出频次为一的词，可获得稳定结果。
pitfalls: 分别出现一次的同词总频次为二，不算不常见
句中单词以单空格分隔
输出顺序任意，这里固定为原始顺序

solutions.title: 合并词频稳定过滤
solutions.idea: 计数后按原输入顺序筛选唯一词。
steps: 把 s1、s2 切分并依次放入 words
再次扫描 words，频次等于一的加入答案

code.java: class Solution { public String[] uncommonFromSentences(String s1,String s2){String[] words=(s1+" "+s2).split(" ");Map<String,Integer> frequency=new HashMap<>();for(String word:words)frequency.merge(word,1,Integer::sum);List<String> answer=new ArrayList<>();for(String word:words)if(frequency.get(word)==1)answer.add(word);return answer.toArray(new String[0]);} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: vector<string> uncommonFromSentences(string s1,string s2){stringstream stream(s1+" "+s2);vector<string> words,answer;unordered_map<string,int> frequency;string word;while(stream>>word){words.push_back(word);++frequency[word];}for(string& value:words)if(frequency[value]==1)answer.push_back(value);return answer;} };
